text:
That pending charge is most likely a card authorisation, not an actual charge. When you place an order, we authorise your card at checkout, and we only charge it when the order ships. Since you cancelled within the 2-hour window, nothing shipped, so you shouldn't be charged.

The authorisation drops off on its own in **3-7 business days**, depending on your bank. Leafy can't release it faster than that, so the timing is up to your bank.

If the charge is still showing after 7 business days, or if it has posted as a completed charge rather than staying pending, contact us at help@leafy.example (we reply within 1 business day) or via chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat). Please have your order number ready (it looks like LF- followed by six digits). Please don't send a full card number, security code or password. If it has posted, we may ask for the last four digits of your card, and that's all we'll need.

Is there anything else I can help with?
